systems.system: Computerised civil registration and e-passport system
systems.tiers: All 10 provincial and 63 district registry offices and more than 20 of 209 sub-offices computerised; e-passport enrolment centres in 10 districts, eight provincial centres and Johannesburg (Deputy Registrar General, July 2026)

note: The offices are the Civil Registry Department's own field offices, a national agency's and out of the study's scope; no local authority office is named. Body is a truncated capture.
